title: Enter opens the focused card or row, and no key drags it
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Ana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Ben" are active at this location, and both are pinned in your Board View (no other technician is pinned).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Enter" has four Approved work orders: units "C368150-U1" and "C368150-U2" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Ana", unit "C368150-U3" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Ben", and unit "C368150-U4" with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Enter", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C368150-U1".
  4. Press Space, then Shift with each arrow key.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Press the browser Back button.
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click once in the "Search" box.
  9. Press Tab until a row shows a focus ring.
  10. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the row for unit "C368150-U1".
  11. Press Enter.
  12. Press the browser Back button.
  13. With the mouse, click the row for unit "C368150-U1" without moving the mouse while the button is down.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 2: a card shows the focus ring.

Step 3: the card for unit "C368150-U1" shows the focus ring.

Step 4: no card moves: unit "C368150-U1" stays in its place in "ZZAUTOTEST C368150 Ana"'s column and no "Lead technician updated" message appears.

Step 5: the work order page for unit "C368150-U1" opens, the same as a click.

Step 6: Board View shows again.

Step 7: Tech View shows the same work orders.

Step 8: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 9: a work order row shows the focus ring.

Step 10: the row for unit "C368150-U1" shows the focus ring.

Step 11: the work order page for unit "C368150-U1" opens.

Step 12: Tech View shows again.

Step 13: the click opens the work order page for unit "C368150-U1", as it does today.
